qualification_scope: Owner-requested UC02 simplification. One visible complete YAML/JSON editor, one direct Save/Cancel to the existing Home Assistant Config Entry, no frontend hidden admin gating or mandatory Review handshake. HA backend still checks authenticated administrator, canonical schema, original revision, physical writer ownership/commissioning and executor-safe structural updates. Externally owned uncommissioned devices may be mapped without invented physical idle evidence. Source tests, installed Home Assistant 2026.11.2 and real Chromium 390/1024/1600 positive/negative including no automatic editor closure, exact-dev/main CI, immutable released full HACS artifact and digest required. Production is real code, no parallel store, stub, simulated charger or new framework.
limitations: Standalone HACS prerelease is tested against real HA code but not yet installed/accepted in Wessels browser or physically commissioned on site. Existing EV Smart Charging remains sole hardware command writer until actual separate electrical/connection/STOP evidence and explicit handover. Source-owned imported YAML remains read-only; physical commands never follow from configuration Save. v0.1.10 is immutable rollback.
